The structure of Eu8Te12O24 (reduced formula Eu2Te3O6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 44 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Eu-centered octahedra share corners, and Eu–Te polyhedra exhibit both corner- and face-sharing contacts, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
